subject: URGENT: Outstanding Vendor Payment Approval - Ref #INV-88342
body:
Dear Finance Team,

I am currently reviewing the month-end accounts payable ledger and noticed that the priority invoice #INV-88342 for Apex Logistics (£14,500.00) is still pending dual authorization in the system.

As this requires immediate sign-off to avoid late processing penalties ahead of the quarterly audit, please review and expedite the secondary approval via the internal portal below as soon as possible:

[SIMULATED LINK: Internal AP Portal Invoice Review]

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Arthur Vance
Chief Financial Officer
Vanguard Financial Services Ltd
